361:             if there are both training and test files with the specified
362:             file extension
363:         """
364:         if ext is None:
365:             return any(
366:                 self._has_files(dataset_name, ext=ext) for ext in SUPPORTED_EXT
367:             )
368:         else:
369:             dataset_name = self._filenames.get(dataset_name, dataset_name)
370:             full_path = self._data_dir / dataset_name
371:             return (
372:                 (full_path / (dataset_name + f"_TRAIN.{ext}")).exists() and
373:                 (full_path / (dataset_name + f"_TEST.{ext}")).exists()
374:             )
375: 
376:     def cache_all(self):
377:         """Cache all datasets from the UCR/UEA archive for later use."""
378:         for dataset_name in self.list_datasets():
379:             try:
380:                 self.load_dataset(dataset_name)
381:             except Exception as exception:
382:                 warnings.warn("Could not cache dataset \"%s\": %s"
383:                               % (dataset_name, str(exception)),
384:                               category=RuntimeWarning, stacklevel=2)
